adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts, the refactor changes calendarReference from a single `_calendar` reference to an array via `.filter(...)` and then updates events in a loop for each reference. However, in the merge-on-reschedule branch (`if (newBookingId)`), it still deletes only one old calendar event using `const oldCalendarEvent = booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"));`. With multiple `_calendar` references (e.g., collective/team bookings), this will delete only the first match and leave the other old calendar events undeleted, causing stale duplicate events for the other hosts.
